sloka: गो लांगूल महाराजो गवाक्षो भीम विक्रमः ।वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण वानराणाम् अदृश्यत ॥४-३९-१९॥
transliteration: go lāṁgūla mahārājo gavākṣo bhīma vikramaḥ ।vṛtaḥ koṭi sahasreṇa vānarāṇām adṛśyata ॥4-39-19॥

translations.english: Next arrived Gavaksha, king of Langurs (whose tail resembled the cow's), of fierceful courage surrounded by a thousand crore of vanaras.
